aria.description: Prefill throughput comparison. Halogen ranks first at 1276.7 tokens per second. Rows align with prefill ranking; each point displays its own rank.
Decode throughput comparison. Ciru-Orca ranks first at 57.7 tokens per second. Rows align with prefill ranking; each point displays its own rank.

Prefill throughput across context depth for 8 models, with 512 new input tokens. Higher is faster. Diamond points mark the fastest model at each measured depth. Lines join measured points without smoothing.

Measured native decode throughput on all ten HumanEval/0–9 code prompts, with thinking off. Each model has a separate line and a direct endpoint label; diamonds mark the fastest model for each task. Higher is faster.
